2024.change_reason: Only year with captured text, so it serves as the baseline and there is no prior year to compare.
2024.analyst_notes: Energetic, inclusive brand voice ('If you have a body, you are an athlete') built on athlete stories and products rather than corporate values. The community and employee-wellbeing statements are short and general, with no metrics on the page; the 'regardless of ... who they love' line is the clearest DEI-type statement.
